subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

His pet dog was killed by__ a flesh eating animal.__
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• 'Flesh eating animal' refers to a creature that primarily consumes the meat of other animals. The English meaning includes animals that eat the flesh of others, primarily carnivorous animals (मांस खाने वाले जानवर).

 
 
• **Example: **The lion is a flesh eating animal and hunts its prey in the wild.
 
 
 
• 'Carnivorous', which is the correct answer, refers to an animal that feeds on other animals. Its English meaning is flesh-eating (मांसाहारी).
 
 
• **​****Example: **The carnivorous lion killed the zebra.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Option 4'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 
• An 'omnivorous' (Option 1) animal or person eats all kinds of food, both plant and animal (सर्वाहारी).
 
• A 'germicide' (Option 2) is an agent that kills germs, especially a chemical agent used for disinfection (रोगाणुनाशक).
 
• A 'herbivorous' (Option 3) animal eats plants and not meat (शाकाहारी).

The correct answer is 'Option 1&
